# Variable `SDK_OS`

### Yocto Project Reference Manual

Specifies the operating system for which the SDK will be built. The default value is the value of BUILD_OS.

Offline source: yocto-manuals/references/manuals/ref-manual/variables.md (online: https://docs.yoctoproject.org/scarthgap/ref-manual/variables.html#term-SDK_OS)
